This makes sense because the rate of the temperature increase possible in a home within 1 hour is limited by physical characteristics, such as the thermal mass of the dwelling and the capacity of the heating equipment. 4.4 Final Selection of Parameters for HVAC Load Flexibility Measure After further reviewing the existing demand response programs and considering the limitations of the likely downstream modeling tools, we eliminated scenarios where load shifting and load shedding were applied at the same time.
